categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Tianyishangjia High-tech Materials Corp., Ltd. operates primarily in four business segments: rail transit, photovoltaic new energy, automotive, and aerospace. The rail transit segment focuses on powder metallurgy brake pads for high-speed trains and other rail vehicles. The photovoltaic segment produces carbon-carbon composite materials and quartz crucibles for solar applications. The automotive segment develops high-performance carbon-ceramic brake discs mainly for new energy vehicles. The aerospace segment manufactures resin-based carbon fiber composites, carbon-based composites, and precision large aerospace structural parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced powder metallurgy technology for manufacturing brake pads, chemical vapor deposition, continuous asphalt impregnation, and carbonization for carbon-carbon composites, and automated production lines for quartz crucibles. It has proprietary technologies in carbon-ceramic brake disc production including preform preparation, chemical vapor deposition, silicon infiltration, and ceramic coating. The aerospace segment employs resin-based composite molding techniques such as hot pressing, molding, winding, and RTM, alongside precision CNC machining for metal aerospace components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national railway bureaus, railway vehicle manufacturers under China Railway Corporation, photovoltaic silicon crystal manufacturers, high-end equipment manufacturers, new energy vehicle OEMs and system integrators, aerospace and defense enterprises including China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation, and aviation manufacturers. The company serves markets in high-speed rail, urban rail transit, photovoltaic solar energy, new energy vehicles, lithium battery anode materials, and aerospace sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with key production bases in Beijing, Tianjin, Jiangyou, Chengdu, and Xuzhou. Its products serve domestic markets extensively, including eastern, central, and western China regions. It also has some international patent coverage and cooperation but the main business and customers are domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianyishangjia operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures core components such as brake pads and composite materials used by OEMs and system integrators in rail transit, automotive, photovoltaic, and aerospace industries. It also provides technical services and product development, positioning itself as a key materials supplier and component manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in new materials and industrial application platforms, focusing on high-speed rail powder metallurgy brake pads, carbon-carbon composites for photovoltaic and lithium battery applications, carbon-ceramic brake discs for new energy vehicles, and aerospace composite materials. R&D priorities include improving product performance under extreme conditions, cost reduction, automation, and digitalization of production. It actively pursues patent development and collaborates with industry leaders to expand applications in emerging sectors like low-altitude economy and commercial aerospace.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of brake pads, composite materials, quartz crucibles, and aerospace components. The company secures orders via bidding, competitive negotiation, and direct sales contracts with OEMs and system integrators. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue is from product manufacturing and sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the rail transit brake pad market, Tianyishangjia holds a leading position with the largest supply volume and extensive certification coverage. In photovoltaic carbon-carbon composites and quartz crucibles, it is a leading player with advanced production capabilities. In automotive carbon-ceramic brake discs, it is an emerging leader breaking foreign monopolies. In aerospace composites and precision manufacturing, it is a growing supplier with recognized technical advantages. Competitors include domestic and international specialized material and component manufacturers in each segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 763 million, a 63.85% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to market downturns in photovoltaic and rail transit sectors. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.495 billion, significantly impacted by asset impairment and inventory write-downs. Despite the downturn, the company maintains substantial total assets of over RMB 6.4 billion and continues investing in R&D with expenditures representing 14.37% of revenue. The company is undergoing a growth and restructuring phase with strategic investments in new product lines and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianyishangjia emphasizes high-quality, domestically developed materials that break foreign technology monopolies, especially in high-speed rail brake pads and carbon-ceramic brake discs. Its products offer superior performance under extreme conditions, longer service life, and cost advantages through advanced manufacturing processes and automation. The company integrates innovation with industrial application platforms, providing customized, high-performance materials for critical sectors such as rail transit, photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, and aerospace, thereby delivering differentiated value to customers.
